title: Message Preserved — Quiet Relay
motionDescription: Vesper Ink aligns and seals the incomplete signal sheet inside a MoonWitness zine folio with a yellow binder clip and magenta tape while Kuro nods; the scene cuts outside to the archive loft rooftop antenna warming up, radiating one delicate concentric cyan-silver radio ring that dissolves into Moon City night mist.

reducedMotionAlternative.description: Serene wide Moon City skyline with deliberate negative space, silver crescent moon above, and quiet rooftop antenna over the warm lit archive loft window.

frames.actingNote: Kuro watches closely from the left while Vesper aligns the partial sheet inside a MoonWitness zine sleeve.
Vesper presses a yellow binder clip and magenta tape strip cleanly onto the folio corner, leaving the blank unknown section visibly unfilled; Kuro nods thoughtfully.
Exterior cut to the archive loft rooftop antenna dish against Moon City dusk-blue sky as a small indicator light glows amber-cyan.
One delicate concentric cyan-silver radio ring radiates quietly off the rooftop antenna over distant apartment windows.
The quiet ring fades outward into drifting night mist while two tiny shadowed silhouettes sit peacefully behind the warm lit loft window far below.
Serene wide Moon City skyline with deliberate negative space, silver crescent moon above, and quiet rooftop antenna below.
